notes: Shure IntelliMix P300 (product line "P300-IMX"). Authoritative source: Shure P300 User Guide (pubs.shure.com/view/guide/P300/en-US.pdf) and Shure P300 Specifications sheet (content-files.shure.com/Pubs/mxa310-p300/p300-imx-spec-sheet-en.pdf), cross-checked against product page shure.com/en-US/products/mixers/p300. Rear-panel parts list (labeled ①–⑧ in the guide): Mobile Input (TRRS 3.5mm, bidirectional — carries stereo-summed-to-mono input plus a return signal to phone on the sleeve); Audio Inputs (2, 3-pin block/Euroblock connectors, "Active Balanced", switchable Line +4dBu or Aux -10dBV sensitivity) — mapped here to connector "euroblock" as the closest listed id for a 3-pin balanced audio block/screw terminal (not literally a "block connector" option in the allowed list); Audio Outputs (2, 3-pin block/Euroblock, "Impedance Balanced", switchable Line/Aux/Mic output level); USB Port (1, USB 2.0 Type-B, single port carries 2 in/2 out channels summed to mono — device explicitly supports USB-B-to-USB-C adapters for host connection); Dante Network Port (1, RJ45, 10 Dante inputs / 8 Dante outputs, also delivers power via 802.3at Type 2 PoE+ Class 4, no separate power inlet exists on this device). Dante/Ethernet grade: guide specifies "Cat5e or higher" cabling and Dante audio at 48kHz/24-bit; Shure does not explicitly state 100M vs 1G link speed in the docs reviewed, so eth-1g is inferred (standard for modern Dante-enabled PoE+ devices requiring Cat5e) rather than confirmed — treat as medium-confidence on that one grade value only. No HDMI/video, no standalone AC or DC power port (device is PoE-powered only). Desktop/tabletop unit (4 x 21 x 22.6 cm / 1.6 x 8.3 x 8.9 in, 1.71 kg) — not natively a rack unit, so rackUnits omitted; optional CRT1 19" tray can hold two P300/ANI units together as a half-rack-width pair but the device itself has no fixed rack-unit height.

ports.name: Dante Network Port
ports.note: Also carries PoE+ power (802.3at Type 2, Class 4) and Designer control data
